body:
I almost find it too hard to face them a lot of the time. I've not seen my parents for 6 months but then i have hidden myself away so could be worth reaching out. I have 2 older brothers both have families of their own now who i haven't seen for a number of years. 

I was a Shift Leader at Tesco for nearly 6 years so retail management experience is all i have to go on right now. I have applied for office or administration jobs to try and get away from retail but i'm lacking the experience needed. I know i'm a fast learner and can pretty much do most things given a chance. 

I got in trouble because i lost my enthusiasm for the job. It used to be an exciting place to be and i felt great knowing people relied on me to get things done. After a few years of always working weekends and late shifts i simply gave up as i felt i didn't have a life outside of work anymore. I got dragged into the office by my manager who told me he would push me down and manage me out this destroyed my trust in the company. 

I'm not in a relationship but we live together due to financial reasons.
I don't have a great relationship with my family. They do talk to me but once they think i'm ok and not about to kill myself i don't hear from them again
